description: The IPO Calendar endpoint provides detailed information on initial public offerings (IPOs), including those that have occurred in the past, are happening today, or are scheduled for the future. Users can access data such as company names, IPO dates, and offering details, allowing them to track and monitor IPO activity efficiently.
